how_built: Thin rectangle around three brand blocks, with gaps in the top and bottom border containing chevrons pointing opposite ways; next to it, trapezoid tags LOW and HIGH linked by a diamond leader to a detail box listing why.
use_for: Ecosystems and flywheels when a stack of products reads more clearly than a wheel.

what_it_does: Compares buyers by logo, with same criteria per column.
how_built: Dark vertical tab with rotated label at left; logos as column headers; short bold criteria text below each. Low-res crop.
use_for: Buyer screens, peer profiles

what_it_does: Makes a fact list read as one connected story from intro plate down.
how_built: Square dark-green tiles with white icons stacked on a short vertical stem below a grey intro plate with heavy base rule. Key figures bold green.
use_for: Acquisition recaps, step lists

element: Acquisition sheet: logo band, diamond leaders, device
what_it_does: Makes each acquired company a repeatable fact card.
how_built: Grey full-width band with target logo centred; target's brand colour vertical line with horizontal branches of growing length ending in a diamond; KPI bold plus italic label; device mockup at right; dashed note below.
use_for: Series of acquisitions, portfolio, subsidiaries

what_it_does: Connects drivers to a chart in reading order and ends with a highlight.
how_built: Thin vertical navy stem with square nodes and italic labels; the last node is a yellow circle, sometimes with a highlighted row. Low-res crop.
use_for: Margin bridges, driver lists

what_it_does: States a cause, mechanism and consequence between a chart and its text in one row.
how_built: Pale rounded band behind; icon + short phrase, then accent block arrow with the verb inside (Exclusion), then outcome + icon; the left edge tucks behind the donut.
use_for: So-what strip beside charts

element: Dashed circuit tying a source to its evidence
what_it_does: Shows that the three charts on a slide are all consequences of one framework.
how_built: A book cover and summary plate; dashed green elbow connectors leave the plate and run to the accent bar of each section heading, avoiding the charts.
use_for: Any framework-to-evidence slide. Connector is drawable; the cover is optional.

what_it_does: Lists executives with less monotony and fits a headshot without a column of faces.
how_built: Full-width pale strips stacked; a small waist-up cut-out alternates left and right, with text aligned to the photo side (bold name and title, regular tenure line).
use_for: Management lists of 2-4 people.

what_it_does: Shows bear, base and bull as a single assumption change with the outcome.
how_built: Three identical grey cards with a thick right and bottom edge in scenario colour; coloured scenario title, target price, upside, a rule, then the sentence naming the varied assumption with only the year coloured.
use_for: Scenario summary driven by one variable.

what_it_does: States the causal bridge between two charts: one party's cost is another's revenue.
how_built: Full-width solid band with white centred sentence between two chart rows; a thin arrow enters from a dashed bar above and leaves toward the chart below.
use_for: Value chain P&Ls, payer-provider logic, two-stage reasoning.

what_it_does: Writes a diagnosis as an equation of words: cause + cause + cause, downward triangle, root cause.
how_built: Rounded grey card with solid red title band; three italic bold red phrases split by pale plus signs; wide flat grey down-triangle; result in larger italic red. P.30 uses it as X >> Y pills then a triangle then a verdict.
use_for: Why something failed, root-cause conclusions, value bridges in words.

what_it_does: Reduces an elasticity or a purchase math to cause-and-effect in two pills and a verdict line.
how_built: Two muted red rounded pills in italic white, pale double chevron between, wide fading triangle below pointing at a one-line conclusion with key words in red.
use_for: Mini-conclusions in the bottom-right of a dense slide.

what_it_does: Numbers reasons discretely, leaving the text free of list markers.
how_built: Grey card with soft bottom-right shadow; small solid square with white bold italic numeral straddling the top-right edge; bold coloured lead-in followed by regular text.
use_for: Short ranked lists of 3-5 items.

what_it_does: Reads as a brief event sequence with lighter weight than bullets.
how_built: Pale rounded pills stacked with even gaps; a small dark gradient disc with white line icon overlaps each pill's left edge; text indented to clear it.
use_for: Event chains, status lists of 3-4.

element: Reasons column closing in a synthesis card
what_it_does: Sends the eye from reasons to conclusion within one column.
how_built: Pale rounded cards with a thick coloured left edge bending around the corners and '01 Title' in bold; the last card is solid brand colour with logo, 'Sintese' and white text, about 1.5x taller.
use_for: Criteria list with a single takeaway at the bottom.

what_it_does: Lets a judge read only the coloured words and still get the slide's claim.
how_built: Two-line full-width grey sentence with a thick dark tick at left; 5-8 phrases set in bold accent colour, which is the only strong colour in the sentence.
use_for: Every content slide; replaces a separate 'key takeaway' box.

element: Brand takeover: palette follows the protagonist
what_it_does: The colour instantly tells whose story is on screen, and a competitor slide reads as foreign territory.
how_built: Swap the whole theme token set by subject: CSN blue to ArcelorMittal red (also Cosan green to Compass red with corner logo swap). Nubank does it for a single slide: rail, accents, pills and corner logo turn Inter orange (p17), MELI logo on p54. Composite crop shows both.
use_for: Two-company deals, holding and subsidiary, competitor deep dive

element: Dark mode reserved for the deal section
what_it_does: Signals the shift from analysis to the proposed transaction without a divider.
how_built: Body slides are white with a dark green rail; from the structure section on, every slide goes black with accent type and faint line texture, returning for Q&A; navigation drops away in favour of the left-hand stepper.
use_for: Separating diagnosis from proposal or valuation.

element: Two-tone tick on titles and subheads
what_it_does: Gives every heading a repeated brand mark and a clear hierarchy without boxes.
how_built: Short vertical bar left of the heading, split dark on top and lighter accent at the bottom where the grey caption sits; same device at title scale and subhead scale.
use_for: Any deck, as signature heading system

what_it_does: Ties the deck visually to engineering and infrastructure.
how_built: Near-black navy page with faint grid lines, small plus marks scattered and a low wireframe mesh wave rising from the base, all under 15% contrast. Pair with thin blue hairlines ending in diamond dots.
use_for: Infrastructure and energy decks

what_it_does: Numbers parallel growth avenues without another agenda slide.
how_built: Top right, below the guest or subject logo: dark green circle with a thin white numeral.
use_for: Series of 2-5 parallel cases

what_it_does: Gives a CEO's credibility in four employer logos rather than a bio paragraph.
how_built: Dashed-border logo boxes joined by short green arrows, turning back on itself with an elbow to the current employer, which is on a grey tile; portrait and bio plate beneath.
use_for: Management slides. Logos only.

what_it_does: Gives every title a small branded mark that repeats across hundreds of slides.
how_built: Vertical bar left of the title and subtitle, cut by a diagonal white slash into solid top and pale gradient bottom; a smaller version marks each subheading. Vasta and Restaurant Brands use a similar slashed bar; Vasta has a rounded pill with two slashes.
use_for: Title mark in any template.

what_it_does: Signals in one icon that the numbers were computed by the team rather than collected.
how_built: Python logo perched on the upper-left corner of a rounded criteria card, card title sitting in a gap in the top border, Roman-number tiles on the criteria list. Cury Construtora p.13 does it as a small blue pill Python Script at the corner of a chart.
use_for: Proprietary scoring, scraping, simulations.

element: Illustration hanging over a card edge
what_it_does: Adds a topical object to a dense data slide without taking layout space.
how_built: Transparent line drawing (fuel nozzle, dripping) placed to break the title band and the right border of the card; only one per slide.
use_for: Sector identity in text-heavy panels.

element: Closing verdict with four numbered cards
what_it_does: Ends on one giant word and compresses the whole deck into three theses plus a risk column.
how_built: Cover photo at top and bottom; translucent dark red band across the middle; BUY! in huge white type; four white rounded cards straddling the band's lower edge, each with a square red tag at its top-left corner hanging off the card (I, II, III, !); red hollow diamond bullets; the risk card title is italic.
use_for: Final slide before Q&A.

what_it_does: Keeps a real asset in the closing and in the index while staying in brand palette.
how_built: Full-bleed photo of the rig under a theme gradient overlay; thin large Q&A centred; same image at lower contrast behind index pages.
use_for: Q&A and index for asset-heavy companies

element: Question answered on the closing slide
what_it_does: Frames the conclusion as a question to the judges and answers with one word and a logo.
how_built: Dark slide with thin-weight question as title; three stacked pentagon arrows in tints of light blue of unequal length, sentence continued across them with ellipses; large grey triangle in the lower-right corner with parallel diagonal bands holding Yes! and the logo.
use_for: Final recommendation.

what_it_does: Sets up the deal with an image tied to the target's identity, not a corporate photo.
how_built: Full-bleed mountain at golden hour for Moncler; only two small logos centered on the sky; firm name small at bottom-right; no title text.
use_for: M&A or brand-led theses where an image carries the idea.

element: Cover ribbon echoing the chevrons of the rail
what_it_does: Introduces the deck's chevron motif on the cover, then repeats it for Q&A with only the text swapped.
how_built: Dark page; white arrow-shaped logo band bleeding from left; thin band with event name and three fading chevrons; phone screen on brand disc.
use_for: Consumer app or brand cover

what_it_does: Extends the shipping-box idea from the cover through the entire appendix.
how_built: Kraft background, two yellow tape-coloured rectangles at left and right with halftone dot grids, a centred title in dark grey. The depth of the kraft label itself is already catalogued; this entry is only the divider pattern.
use_for: Section dividers when the company has a physical product metaphor

element: Ghost numeral divider with chapter tabs
what_it_does: Gives the deck a calm rhythm and shows the chapter number and position in the same slide.
how_built: Pale background; huge number in a very light tint of the accent behind and above a heavy black chapter title; short accent rule; italic subtitle; a row of six small number-over-label tabs split by thin vertical rules, the active one in accent with an underline.
use_for: Section dividers; works with any accent colour.

element: Bare verdict word on thesis page
what_it_does: Makes the recommendation the largest, quietest thing on the page.
how_built: Dark page: thin frame open on the left with price pairs at top (current to target, joined by a capped rule) and return pairs at bottom (IRR, FCFE); between them a single thin-weight accent 'BUY'; three thesis pillars branch off a diagonal as small pill nodes with italic labels.
use_for: Opening thesis or investment summary.

what_it_does: Makes a compensation policy memorable: the whole cake must grow, not just the slice.
how_built: Pale panel; small and large cake line icons linked by a loose sketched arrow; second line outside the panel, with a slice icon in a contrasting colour, completing the sentence.
use_for: Incentive or culture points hard to chart.

element: Verdict title on full-bleed price line
what_it_does: Places the recommendation next to the price path that justifies it.
how_built: Dark gradient page; title is ticker and verdict ('RDOR3 - HOLD'); price line takes most of the page, with a dashed horizontal at the target price labelled on the line; a stat cluster at right gives DCF, IRR and current price.
use_for: Recommendation opener, especially a nuanced hold.

what_it_does: Stamps the conclusion of a flow diagram as a verdict.
how_built: Dashed horizontal leader from the panel into an accent circle with thick white rim and outer ring, white value and label ('18.1% Premium').
use_for: End result of a structure or mechanism.
